l-e-m2-b03-06.material: as many books as / as much water as / as many friends as / as much money as. Poiščite merilo, ki te štiri zveze razdeli na many in much.
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.prompt: Katero merilo loči many in much?
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.o.a: Ali lahko samostalnik za njim štejemo posamezno
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.o.b: Ali je samostalnik za njim povezan z ljudmi
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.r.b: Books in water sta obe stvari, vendar se razvrstita v many in much.
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.r.d: To, ali je nekaj drago, nima zveze z many in much.
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s1.explain: Books in friends lahko štejemo, zato uporabimo many. Water in money opisujeta količini, ki ju ne štejemo posamezno, zato uporabimo much.
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s2.model.0: Books in friends lahko štejemo po enega, zato uporabimo many. Water in money sta količini, ki ju ne štejemo po posameznih enotah, zato uporabimo much.
l-e-m2-b03-06.s.s2.model.1: Many in much se ne ločita po številu besed ali ceni, temveč po tem, ali je samostalnik števni. To je merilo.
